result.title: TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities
result.summary: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 TartanMatch，用轻量模态适配和真实/合成数据混合，把 RGB 预训练的对应模型扩展为覆盖 RGB、事件、热成像、深度、投影 LiDAR 共 25 个有序模态对的统一稠密对应模型，并在零样本真实基准上大幅降低 EPE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「轻量模态适配 + 多模态对联合训练带来正向迁移」的机制，可能为 LVR 中跨模态视觉细节的保留与共享 latent 空间的信息坍缩问题提供可核查的适配与训练线索；但论文本身不涉及推理、证据使用或 latent 状态生成，联系较弱。
